description: Figure 2 presents the original distribution of emotion categories as found in the IEMOCAP dataset, representing the proportion of utterances associated with each emotion. The chart consists of six slices, visually arranged in descending order by proportion. The slices represent the emotions of Happiness (light blue, approximately 25.1%), Sadness (dark blue, approximately 23.1%), Neutral (grey, approximately 23.1%), Anger (red, approximately 14.9%), Excitement (orange, approximately 14.7%), and Frustration (green, approximately 8.1%). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. There is a legend identifying each emotion with its corresponding color. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
